column1: # The pool behind the ubuntu-latest `Tests (pytest)` row of step_margin_baseline.toml, measured 2026-10-18 UTC.
# Every ci.yml run with event merge_group, pull_request, push or workflow_dispatch created 2026-10-13T09:35:29Z..2026-10-18T13:41:05Z UTC,
# listed per event in 12-hour slices; jobs read with ?filter=all on 2026-10-18 between about 14:10Z and 14:13Z UTC.
# One line per ubuntu engine job execution (every attempt), or one no-job line for a run without that job.
# step_s is the step's completed_at minus started_at, in seconds. keep says whether the line is a row of the pool.
# The row's `source` in step_margin_baseline.toml states the counts this file reproduces.
